name: @zyo/yield
description: Oilskin yield service (Base-first): live Aave v3 USDC borrow + collateral supply/LT from the PoolDataProvider, Aerodrome gauge emissions per range width, the IL-drag yield gate, and empirical realized-APR bands from the Snuggle engine's on-chain history — served over a small HTTP API. Zero runtime dependencies by design.

scripts.model: npm run model-inputs && python3 scripts/lp-sim.py --sample samples/gauge-emissions-2026-09-05-composite.json --vol samples/volatility.json --inputs samples/model-inputs.json --as-of 2026-08-31T01:34:32Z --borrow 4.828 --borrow-source 'Aave v3 Base PoolDataProvider getReserveData(USDC) variableBorrowRate, read live 2026-09-05 ~01:00Z (docs/VERIFIED-BASE-FACTS.md)' --supply cbBTC=0.012,WETH=1.843 --lt cbBTC=7800,WETH=8300 --out samples/lp-model-2026-09-05.json --md samples/MODEL-NUMBERS.md --calibration samples/mc-calibration.json
